name: LCM Student Center

steps.text: On the corner of N Mills St and University Ave, next to the Chemistry building.
Look for the “You Belong” banner and go in through the double doors.
We set up in the kitchen area. Look for the Badger Supports banner.

note: Badger Supports is a secular student organization, and we are grateful to the LCM team for welcoming us into the space.
source: Live page /operations/directions/lcm, read 2026-10-19. Its three pictures (the street map, the entrance, the banner) are the live page’s own, saved with the owner’s approval on 2026-10-20; the owner kept the banner photo for now.
